prompts.welcome: Before we start, one quick thing, the more detail you share, the stronger and more accurate your plan will be. Give me the full picture, and I’ll take it from there. Let’s get into it.
prompts.goal_name: Alright, first things first. What’s the specific goal you want to work toward? Tell me exactly what you’re aiming for.
prompts.goal_description: When everything goes right, what does “done” look like for you? Describe the outcome as clearly as you can.
prompts.goal_importance: Why does this goal matter to you right now? And when you hit it, what changes for you?
prompts.target_date: When would you like to reach this goal? Is that a firm deadline or more of an ideal target?
prompts.weekly_commitment: How much time can you realistically put in each week, and what kind of pace works best for you? Short daily steps, a few focused sessions, or something more flexible?
prompts.frequency: Where are you starting from today? Share anything you’ve already done, what you know, or any background that helps me understand your baseline.
prompts.constraints: What potential obstacles could get in your way? And which ones feel like the biggest roadblocks? These can be internal or external (i.e., Internal: finding the willpower to wake up early, External: Work or family obligations.)
prompts.skill_level: Are there any limits, conditions, or personal preferences I should keep in mind? This could be schedule constraints, budget considerations, physical factors, tools you can or cannot use, or anything you want included or avoided.
prompts.anything_else: Anything else you want me to know before I build your roadmap? Add any details or context that would help shape the plan.
prompts.thank_you: Perfect. I’ve got everything I need. I’m putting your roadmap together now, and it should take about 2 to 3 minutes. Sit tight, I’ll let you know the moment it’s ready.
prompts.additional_context: Anything else you want me to know before I build your roadmap? Add any details or context that would help shape the plan.

page1.headline: Dead Reckoner
page1.body:
Most tools help you plan. We help you move.

Long-term goals you've never started. Self-improvement you know you need. Habits you keep starting over.

We don't care what it is. We break it into daily steps and keep you moving until it's done.

page2.headline: Accountability Changes Everything
page2.body:
Private goals are easy to abandon. Make one visible to someone you trust and watch what happens.

Share everything with one person, or choose someone different for each.

They see what you share. They get notified when you stall.

You stop letting yourself off the hook.

setup_task.title: Set up Dead Reckoner
setup_task.description: This takes under two minutes. Do this once to get oriented.
setup_task.step_review_today_details: This page always shows your next action. You do not need to plan your day here, just execute what appears.
setup_task.step_create_review_roadmap_details: Roadmaps create the tasks you see on Today. Once created, review the first milestone and start the roadmap if everything looks right. Roadmaps can be found under the Progress tab.
setup_task.step_invite_friend: Invite a friend to the app for accountability
setup_task.step_invite_friend_details:
Go to your Profile, then My Friends. Search for a friend, or send them an invite if they are not on the app. 
Why this matters: Having someone see your progress makes follow through far more likely.
setup_task.step_add_anchor: Add an Anchor to your roadmap
setup_task.step_add_anchor_details:
Open your roadmap, tap the Anchor icon, and select a friend. Anchors can see your progress and get notified if you fall behind. 
Why this matters: Anchors turn intention into commitment.
setup_task.step_complete_task_details: Once these steps are all checked off, this task will disappear and your real work begins.
setup_task.completion_message: You are set. Just do what shows up here.

feature_highlight.roadmap_intro_message: The Roadmap page gives you a clear view of your goal, your progress, and what comes next. Your roadmap is organized into phases, phases contain milestones, milestones contain tasks, and some tasks may include multiple steps. That may sound like a lot, but don't worry, we'll show you exactly what to do each day.
feature_highlight.roadmap_overview_message: Overview gives you a high-level summary of your roadmap and your overall progress.
feature_highlight.anchor_message: Your anchor is someone you trust who helps keep you accountable and on track. Use the Friends and Accountability features to invite a friend to join the app, then ask them to be your anchor so they can help keep you moving forward.
feature_highlight.phase_message: This shows the phase you are currently in. A phase is a major stage of your roadmap made up of related milestones. Open it to see the milestones in this phase.
feature_highlight.milestone_message: This shows the milestone you are currently working on. Milestones are completed by finishing the tasks inside them. Open it to see the tasks in this milestone.
feature_highlight.manage_roadmap_message: Tap the menu to manage your roadmap. From here you can pause or restart it, shift or realign dates, archive it, manage your share link, and more.
